summary: Frontend verification of Admin Gallery delete + feature flows. Both buttons work correctly end-to-end. DELETE /api/media/{id} returns 200, item is optimistically removed from grid, Sonner toast 'Deleted' appears, console logs the expected 'delete response 200 {ok: true}'. Feature toggle PATCH /api/media/{id} returns 200 and persists.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is ~557 lines — consider splitting per-tab into sub-components for maintainability, but not blocking.

deleteMedia performs optimistic local filter on success; that's fine. Feature toggleFeatured, however, still calls refresh() after PATCH which triggers 5 parallel GETs (media/bookings/contact/settings/reviews). Consider local-state update like deleteMedia for consistency and fewer requests.
seed_data_creation: None — 2 existing media items were available in Gallery; deleted 1 during test, toggled featured on 1. Final grid has 1 item (featured).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login and token storage key is 'gfb_token'. page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept())) works for window.confirm. Delete button selector: [data-testid='delete-{id}']; feature star: [data-testid='feature-{id}']. Console log 'delete response <status> <body>' is emitted by deleteMedia in AdminDashboard.jsx; use this for future regressions. Note: page.evaluate reading localStorage.getItem returned empty in the execution context BEFORE navigation settled — we used network events instead as source of truth and they confirmed 200 responses.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously reported delete issue (button not triggering) is RESOLVED. Root cause of original bug (before fix): action buttons were inside 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' which rendered them invisible and non-interactive on touch devices; the wrapper div also lacked z-index so image siblings absorbed taps. Current fix in AdminDashboard.jsx makes the button container 'z-20' and 'pointer-events-auto' with always-visible styling, plus e.stopPropagation() + e.preventDefault() + type='button'. Verified via Playwright: DELETE network request fires (200), console logs 'delete response 200 {ok: true}', DOM count of [data-testid^=delete-] decreased by 1, and toast 'Deleted' appears. Reproduction steps and mitigation no longer needed — fix is in place.
